build_fbnet_v2_model: build an FBNetV2 model from an architecture definition using FBNetBuilder and build_blocks
test_fbnet_v2_scriptable: test that a fused FBNetV2 model can be TorchScripted and produces matching output
test_fbnet_v2_empty_batch: test that a TorchScripted FBNetV2 model handles zero-batch input correctly
fuse_fbnet_v2_model: fuse a built FBNetV2 model using fuse_utils to combine batch norm into conv layers
save_torchscript_model: save a TorchScripted FBNetV2 model to a .jit file using torch.jit.save
